subject.title: fix(kimi): engage code mode for Kimi Code K3 under tools.codeMode auto

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change existing Kimi K3 `tools.codeMode: "auto"` users from direct tools to the code-mode bridge once after-fix runtime proof confirms the catalog alignment?
rationale: The patch changes the runtime tool surface for existing provider users and is protected by the `maintainer` label; code inspection alone cannot choose acceptance of that upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept aligned K3 behavior
options.body: Approve the K3 metadata alignment after a redacted after-fix run confirms that `auto` engages code mode and unset remains unchanged.

options.title: Retain current Kimi behavior
